drums.tags: Industrial percussion loop. The track consists of a dry, metallic kick drum hitting on every beat at 120 BPM. A high-pitched, resonant metallic clink functions as a snare substitute on beats two and four. A syncopated, low-frequency wooden block or rimshot sound plays on the sixteenth-note offbeats between beats three and four. The mix is entirely dry with no reverb or spatial effects, emphasizing a raw, mechanical texture.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Main Loop]
[dry metallic kick drum on every beat]
[resonant metallic clink on beats 2 and 4]
[syncopated wooden rimshot on sixteenth-note offbeats]

bass.tags: Industrial hip hop. A distorted, overdriven kick drum plays a syncopated pattern with a heavy emphasis on the downbeat. A metallic, high-pitched percussive hit functions as a snare on the backbeat. A low-frequency sine wave sub-bass follows the kick pattern. A recurring, dissonant two-note synth motif with a gritty, saw-tooth texture repeats every two bars. The tempo is 90 BPM in 4/4 time. The mix is characterized by heavy saturation and a narrow stereo field. A rhythmic, mechanical clicking sound occurs on every sixteenth note.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, mechanical clicking]

[Main Loop]
[sub-bass enters, metallic snare hits]
[dissonant saw-tooth synth motif]
